name: cfg-agent-fallback-model-ignored
about: agent.fallbackModel 在 gateway 轮次里不生效（pilot/config/loadPilotConfig.ts:403-412：出现即警告 CONFIG_AGENT_FALLBACK_MODEL_DEPRECATED、值被丢弃；回退只看 router.fallback.default，router/config/parseRouterConfig.ts）。主模型 bbx/broken 一直回 500（retry 设成不重试），agent.fallbackModel 指向能用的 bbx/deterministic：基线这一轮以模型错误结束，回退模型收不到请求；resolve_settings 里看 agent 段与诊断。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/broken
  fallbackModel: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        streamMaxRetries: 0
        requestMaxRetries: 0
      models:
        broken:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
